# National

This folder groups national and sub-national locations, as well as specific hospital wards, that serve as geographical or organizational benchmarks in the Danish Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) quality reports. It contains the overarching national statistics for Denmark, alongside specific high-performing areas like Randers and Region Syd, and clinical wards such as IMA and ITA-afsnit where acute pre-optimization takes place. Together, these pages map the geographical and departmental landscapes where acute surgical quality indicators are measured, reported, and improved.

## Pages

- [[danmark|Danmark]] — Aggregates national-level statistics, mortality rates, and compliance percentages for all acute surgery quality indicators across the country.
- [[ima|IMA]] — A clinical ward location referenced in the context of pre-optimizing acute surgical patients and the application of specific anesthesia procedure codes.
- [[ita-afsnit|ITA-afsnit]] — An intensive or intermediate ward location associated with patient pre-optimization and coding uncertainties for anesthesiologists.
- [[randers|Randers]] — Highlighted as a "best practice" hospital location for achieving significant, multi-year improvements in acute CT scan wait times.
- [[region-syd|Region Syd]] — A regional designation noted for double-digit percentage improvements in quality metrics across several of its constituent hospitals.
